svg.title: Foreground / background Pareto plots
svg.desc: Descriptive only. Lower foreground p95 (ms) and higher background throughput (units/s) are preferred. Each panel uses common complete paired blocks. Small symbols: individual blocks; large: equal-block means. Circle=baseline; diamond=candidate. Dashed segment joins nondominated means only. See pareto.csv and ledger.json.
